description: One post by ID. view=post (default): caption, status, scheduled time, when it was created and by whom (account and channel, such as dashboard, API, or MCP), media, and platform info. view=missing: whether the post is missing required content, media, account, platform settings, or metadata before it can publish; use it to repair failed or imported posts.
